```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)

final_data <- read_csv("data/processed/final_data.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
final_data_copilot <- read_csv(
  "data/processed/final_data_copilot.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

key <- c("iso", "year")
comparison_variables <- setdiff(intersect(names(final_data), names(final_data_copilot)), key)
```

# Overview

This report compares `final_data.csv`, produced by `create_final_data.R`, with
`final_data_copilot.csv`, produced by `create_final_data_copilot.R`. The
comparison checks the data structure, country--year identifiers, values, and
missingness. Both files contain `r nrow(final_data)` observations and
`r ncol(final_data)` variables.

# Structure and identifiers

Both data sets use `iso` and `year` as country--year identifiers. Each contains
`r sum(duplicated(final_data[key]))` duplicated keys in `final_data` and
`r sum(duplicated(final_data_copilot[key]))` in `final_data_copilot`.

```{r}
#| label: structure-comparison
#| echo: false

structure_comparison <- tibble(
  dataset = c("final_data", "final_data_copilot"),
  observations = c(nrow(final_data), nrow(final_data_copilot)),
  variables = c(ncol(final_data), ncol(final_data_copilot)),
  duplicate_country_year_keys = c(
    sum(duplicated(final_data[key])),
    sum(duplicated(final_data_copilot[key]))
  ),
  sorted_by_iso_year = c(
    identical(final_data[key], arrange(final_data, iso, year)[key]),
    identical(
      final_data_copilot[key],
      arrange(final_data_copilot, iso, year)[key]
    )
  )
)

kable(structure_comparison, caption = "Dataset structure and key checks")
```

```{r}
#| label: key-comparison
#| echo: false

keys_only_in_final <- anti_join(final_data[key], final_data_copilot[key], by = key)
keys_only_in_copilot <- anti_join(final_data_copilot[key], final_data[key], by = key)

kable(
  tibble(
    check = c("Country--year keys found only in final_data",
              "Country--year keys found only in final_data_copilot"),
    n = c(nrow(keys_only_in_final), nrow(keys_only_in_copilot))
  ),
  caption = "Country--year key differences"
)
```

The country--year panels are the same: no keys occur in only one file, neither
file has duplicate keys, and both are sorted by `iso` and `year`.

# Variable order and types

The files have the same variable names and data types. Their only structural
presentation difference is column order: `final_data` places `drought` before
`earthquake`, whereas `final_data_copilot` reverses those two columns. This
does not change the data values or their interpretation.

```{r}
#| label: column-order
#| echo: false

final_data_names <- names(final_data)
copilot_names <- names(final_data_copilot)

column_order <- tibble(
  position = seq_len(ncol(final_data)),
  final_data = final_data_names,
  final_data_copilot = copilot_names,
  same_position = final_data_names == copilot_names
)

kable(
  filter(column_order, !same_position),
  caption = "Columns occurring in different positions"
)
```

# Values and missingness

The data sets are joined by country and year before values are assessed. A value
is considered the same when both entries are missing or when their non-missing
values are equal.

```{r}
#| label: value-comparison
#| echo: false

joined_data <- full_join(
  final_data,
  final_data_copilot,
  by = key,
  suffix = c(".final", ".copilot")
)

value_comparison <- map_dfr(comparison_variables, function(variable) {
  final_values <- joined_data[[paste0(variable, ".final")]]
  copilot_values <- joined_data[[paste0(variable, ".copilot")]]
  values_match <- (is.na(final_values) & is.na(copilot_values)) |
    (!is.na(final_values) & !is.na(copilot_values) &
       final_values == copilot_values)

  tibble(
    variable,
    differing_values = sum(!values_match),
    missing_in_final_data = sum(is.na(final_values)),
    missing_in_final_data_copilot = sum(is.na(copilot_values)),
    missingness_difference = sum(is.na(final_values)) - sum(is.na(copilot_values))
  )
})

kable(value_comparison, caption = "Value and missingness comparison by variable")
```

All `r nrow(value_comparison)` shared analysis variables have zero differing
values and identical missingness counts. In particular, the exposure
(`armed_conflict`), disaster indicators (`drought` and `earthquake`), mortality
outcomes, and covariates agree for every country--year record.

# Conclusion

`final_data` and `final_data_copilot` are analytically equivalent. They contain
the same country--year panel, the same variable set and types, identical values,
and identical missing-data patterns. The Copilot script additionally makes the
sort order and unique country--year-key check explicit; its swapped disaster
column order is cosmetic. Either data set will yield the same results in
analyses that reference variables by name.
